claimChallenged: That Parmana holds its own handling of challenges to the standard it applies to runtime outcomes: a public commenter asked how the trace from an assumption being questioned to what changed is kept as a durable, checkable record (RFC-0022, Summary).

source.attribution: A public commenter; not named in RFC-0022.

investigationSteps.method: Surveyed every document that recorded past challenges: 04-INCIDENTS-LOG.md, docs/VERIFICATION-GAPS.md, the TRL 7 verification page, RFC motivations and the docs/CLAIMS.md Key Compromise Notice (RFC-0022, Background). The exact date is not recorded; this is the latest date the cited sources support.
investigationSteps.observation: The investigations were rigorous, but the records were spread over five formats with no shared identifier, schema or lifecycle; 04-INCIDENTS-LOG.md had gone stale and omitted G-24; a challenge ruled out had nowhere to be recorded.

finding.statement: There was no single, structured, durable record of what Parmana had been challenged on, what was checked and what changed.

outcome.description: The ChallengeRecord type, repository and challenge_records table (RFC-0022), scripts/record-challenge.ts to write one, and governance/challenges/ as the public copy. The first record written going forward is CR-2026-10-001.

disclosure.location: docs/rfcs/RFC-0022-Challenge-Record.md and governance/challenges/, in this public repository
